with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings in the aforesaid criminal case as against him.

4. Learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1 and learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 have opposed the petition.
Perusal of the material available on record would go to show that petitioner is the elder brother of accused No.1 and is residing in Bidar along with his family members.
It is stated in the petition that petitioner is working at District Veetor Borne Discase Control Office, Bidar.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Accused No.1 and respondent No.2 after their marriage are residing at Kalaburagi and impugned criminal case has been registered by Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, Kalaburagi against accused No.1 and his relatives.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. Perusal of the first information would go to show that omnibus allegations are made as against the present petitioner and there are no specific allegations as against the petitioner, which would attract the charge sheeted offences.

Under the circumstances, continuation of the impugned criminal proceedings as against the petitioner would not only cause untold hardship and embarrassment to him but the same also would amount to abuse of process of law and therefore, to secure the ends of justice, it is necessary to quash the impugned NC: 2025:KHC-K:84 proceedings as against the petitioner.
Hence, the following order is passed:
ORDER The criminal petition is allowed.

The entire proceedings in C.C.No.5617/2023 pending before the Court of I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC,
Kalaburagi arising out of Crime No.33/2023, registered by Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, Kalaburagi for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 323, 504,
506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 as against petitioner/accused No.4 stands quashed.
